description: Search the live public web when the user needs current information, sources, or research. Returns citable results with id, title, URL, and text. Each result includes a URL that can be read in full.

crawl_results.description: How many top results to also read in full, so their text holds the whole page instead of a snippet. Each successful page retrieval adds 1 credit to the base 1-credit search request

exclude_sites.description: Domains to exclude from the search

include_sites.description: Domains to include when the user explicitly scopes the search

max_results.description: How many sources the answer needs; a handful suits most questions, more suits a broad survey

page.description: Which page of results to fetch when the first page was not enough; only bing, bingcn, and grokipedia paginate, other engines ignore it

search_service.description: Search engine to use; choose one only when it matches the user's source intent

time_range.description: Restrict results to those published recently, for time-sensitive questions; leave unset for evergreen topics

name: search

results.description: Matching sources, most relevant first; read any url in full with crawl

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: Web search
